_comment: Single source of truth for the gardener schedule-bead <-> prompt-.md mapping.
Consumed by scripts/check-gardener-prompt-drift.py (the drift alarm) and referenced
by README.md's Syncing section. Add a row here when a gardener's schedule bead is
created; move a retired predecessor to README's retired table (not here).
'name' MUST equal the .md basename (<name>.md) for an inline-copy gardener. A
runbook-DELEGATING gardener instead carries a 'runbook' key naming its versioned
docs/runbooks/<x>.md; it has NO gardener-prompts/<name>.md and the alarm asserts the
runbook exists AND the live prompt still references it (ka-0000002202, design
ka-0000003223 §3), rather than diffing an inline body. 'bead' is the live schedule bead id.
ONLY LIVE gardeners belong here. A row pinning a CLOSED bead makes the alarm byte-diff a
dead bead's frozen prompt and emit a PHANTOM verdict for a lane no gardener runs — which
trains the fleet to ignore the alarm and silently re-opens the drift bug (the intake
precedent: ka-0000003148 / design ka-0000003223). Before adding OR keeping a row, resolve
the live enabled bead by role (`gb trigger list`, status=open enabled=true); if the lane
retired, move it to README's Retired-predecessors table instead of leaving a dead row here.
